# Investment Update: High Yielders

Report 145 | Published 2024-09-15 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-9-15/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/145.json)

Income stocks, China policy, and crypto selectivity.

The skeptical rate-cut view and subsequent dollar rebound were concrete strengths. Realty Income dividend growth and price-floor tests and EPD threshold/payout calls are supported. China stimulus arrived promptly, but inferred motives and decade analogies remain unverified. Relative crypto/high-yield theses need careful universes and horizons; tobacco migration and producer profitability should not erase declining volumes or weaker earnings.

**Coverage:** Complete source read including all macro/China sections, digital assets, Altria, Realty Income, EPD, Chevron and closing valuation argument. Quoted 2022 altcoin thesis remains a repeated family. Market-implied rate cuts are distinguished from the author explicit skepticism.

At fixed net interest-bearing assets, the direct interest-income effect is mechanically positive. It does not include discount-rate, demand or currency effects on Alphabetstock.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Deductive assessment:**

- CashC and repricing debtD fixed
- Equal rate changeΔr on both
- C>D
- Exclude taxes and all indirect effects

Change in net interest income=(C-D)*Δr, positive for net cash when rates rise.
